user.title: Connect your Omoda / Jaecoo account
user.description: For the European OMODA JAECOO app only (not CarLinko). Use your account password, not the vehicle control PIN. Signing in may disconnect the official app. Your password is used once and is not saved; session tokens are stored locally. Setup and polling only read cloud data. Remote commands are disabled by default and require separate opt-in after setup.

data_description.country_code: Digits only, without +. For example, 44 for the UK. This does not change the EU backend.

vehicles.title: Choose vehicles
vehicles.description: Select which authorized vehicles to add. Each vehicle gets its own device and sensors. Only existing cloud snapshots will be read.

pin.title: Vehicle control PIN (optional)
pin.description: Save your separate vehicle control PIN to enable optional lock/climate commands later, or leave this blank for read-only use. It is NOT your account password. The PIN is not verified during setup; it is only submitted for an explicit command after you enable controls. It is stored in HA configuration/backups, which are not automatically encrypted. Change or remove it later using Reconfigure.

data_description.control_pin: 4–8 digits, including leading zeros. Leave blank to avoid storing a PIN.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The saved session for this account can no longer be used. Enter its account password again. This may disconnect the official app. Your selected vehicles and optional PIN are kept; the password is not saved.

reconfigure.title: Change or remove the control PIN
reconfigure.description: Leave the new PIN blank to keep it, or select Remove saved PIN. No verification request is sent here. Entering a PIN explicitly clears the local safety block from a previous failed/inconclusive check: confirm the correct PIN in the app before retrying. Stored PINs are included in your HA configuration/backups.

error.invalid_auth: Sign-in was rejected or the session expired. Check your account password and that you use the EU OMODA JAECOO app. Do not repeatedly retry. Accounts requiring a verification challenge are not supported yet.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the cloud service. Check connectivity and try again later.
error.rate_limited: The service is limiting requests. Wait before trying again.
error.api_error: The service returned an unexpected response. No vehicle command was sent. Try again later or check compatibility with your app/region.
error.no_vehicles: No authorized vehicles were found. Check vehicle binding and account permissions in the official app.
error.invalid_email: Enter the email address used for your app account.
error.invalid_country: Enter a country dialling code using 1–4 digits, without + or a leading zero.
error.invalid_selection: Select at least one of the discovered vehicles.
error.invalid_pin: Enter 4–8 digits, or leave the PIN blank. This is not your account password.
error.pin_conflict: Enter a new PIN or select Remove saved PIN, not both.

abort.already_configured: This EU account is already configured.
abort.vehicle_already_configured: A selected vehicle is already configured through another account. Keep only one integration entry per vehicle to avoid conflicting sessions and duplicate sensors.
abort.setup_expired: Setup expired. Start again to sign in.
abort.reconfigure_successful: PIN settings updated. No PIN verification or vehicle command was sent.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: Sign in with the same account used for this integration.
abort.vehicle_access_changed: The account no longer provides access to one or more selected vehicles. Check its permissions, or remove and set up the integration again. Existing settings were not replaced.

init.title: Polling and optional remote controls
init.description: Polling only reads cloud snapshots and never wakes the car. Enabling remote controls adds native Lock and Climate entities; using their actions or automations can physically unlock or operate the vehicle. Commands are experimental, require the correct PIN and permissions, and have NOT been validated on your car. API acceptance does not prove completion: check the Command status sensor and the vehicle. No MQTT acknowledgement or automatic wake is used. Start with a supervised test while safely parked. Climate duration must match a duration reported by your vehicle.

error.invalid_interval: Choose a whole number from 5 to 60 minutes.
error.invalid_duration: Choose a whole number from 1 to 60 minutes. The vehicle must also report this duration as supported.
error.pin_required: Save the vehicle control PIN using Reconfigure before enabling controls.
error.pin_blocked: Controls are paused after an unsuccessful/inconclusive PIN check. Verify the correct PIN in the app, then re-enter it using Reconfigure.

state.confirmation_timeout: Lock state not confirmed — check vehicle
